evidence: Executed fixed-case reduced-model numerical comparisons; no optimized candidate, empirically validated structure, full control/hardware closure, long-duration orbital service, continuous coverage or collision certificate.
reading_rule: Fixed short numerical tests, not a coupled search. Preserve failures and invalid prefixes. Compare physical probes across mesh/mode bases, not modal coordinates. Positive sampled coverage is not continuous coverage.

case_plan.period_cost_rule: 12 DOP853 stages per bounded step plus 50 startup calls, priced at the measured reference cost per RHS; if projected wall time exceeds 300 s, requested duration is capped at 1000 s. This is a rough resource estimate, not solver accuracy.

solver_comparison.rule: Same geometry, state, loads, requested tolerances and maximum step. Agreement between methods is a numerical check, not a validated error bound. Cost is measured for this fixed prefix only.

absolute_tolerance_pilot.reading_rule: A reproducible two-second tolerance/startup check. Dimensioned absolute tolerances express distinct physical units; they do not relax rtol or establish general physical accuracy.

resolution_assessment.criterion: maximum common physical shape-probe difference <= 0.1 mm + 1% of reference peak probe displacement; a declared benchmark criterion, not a physical requirement or certified error bound
resolution_assessment.complete_basis_definition: all N-3 elastic normal degrees of freedom after three affine rigid normal modes are removed: mesh8=82, mesh12=170, mesh16=290
resolution_assessment.reading_rule: Do not infer mesh convergence from a six-mode mesh sequence. Full discrete bases remove modal truncation for each mesh, but leave mesh geometry, assumed stiffness, endpoint inertia and all physical-model limitations.

one_three_tile.rule: Measured one/three-tile fixed-prefix cost only; no linear large-fleet extrapolation, optimizer budget or accepted service duration.

limits: normal-only linear prestress model with assumed finite support compliances
endpoint-lumped support inertia and polygonal approximation to circular scallops
short circular lunar point-mass benchmark, fixed source direction, no Earth/Sun gravity or eclipses
zero assumed damping; no in-plane motion, wrinkling, thermal distortion or nonlinear constitutive response
triangle-centroid photons with sampled solar directions and receiver rays; hardware shadows unmeshed
instantaneous AABB separation lower bounds; no continuous clearance/contact certificate
no solved large rolled service command, propulsion, storage, bus or equipment reaction budget
no coupled parameter search or optimizer executed
